'''Gecee''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and a rival of [[Fenig Nabon]]. Gecee's ineptitude usually meant that Nabon beat him to the good jobs, a fact that rankled the Gran. Both Nabon and Gecee were involved in a barroom brawl at the [[Black Dust Tavern]], on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. After Nabon knocked him unconscious, Gecee attacked Fen when she returned to the ''[[Star Lady]]''. Gecee would have shot Nabon if [[Ghitsa Dogder]] hadn't grabbed his ear and immobilized him.<ref name="Credit" />
